mapper.insert: INSERT INTO travel_plan_chat_images (message_id, storage_key, content_type, byte_size, width, height, sort_order) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{storageKey}, #{contentType}, #{byteSize}, #{width}, #{height}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT i.* FROM travel_plan_chat_images i JOIN travel_plan_chat_messages m ON m.id = i.message_id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.message_id IN #{id} ORDER BY i.message_id, i.sort_order
SELECT * FROM travel_plan_chat_images WHERE id = #{id} AND message_id = #{messageId}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM travel_plan_chat_images i JOIN travel_plan_chat_messages m ON m.id = i.message_id WHERE i.storage_key = #{storageKey} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL)
